description: Instituciones Educativas Publicas de San José de Cúcuta con servicio de conectividad a Internet is a dataset listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by Alcaldía de San José de Cúcuta, Norte de Santander. Se relacionan todas las instituciones educativas publicas beneficiadas con la prestación del servicio gratuito de conectividad a Internet por medio de fibra óptica, el servicio de Internet facilita el acceso a la información, la comunicación y el entretenimiento de los estudiantes y docentes. Coverage: Alcaldía de San José de Cúcuta, Norte de Santander. The portal files it under the publisher Alcaldía de San José de Cúcuta, Norte de Santander. Its tags are educación pública, colegios, servicios, tic, instituciones educativas. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal files it under the category Ciencia, Tecnología e Innovación. The portal shows 2022-10-25 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datos-gov-co-portal.
